kfn_real_pois.description: kFN query: COL-Tree achieves exact results while pruning the search space. Scored on machine-independent metrics: accuracy and candidate reduction ratio.

candidates_ratio.description: Fraction of objects requiring exact distance verification. Lower = more efficient pruning.

lookup_reduction_vs_brute.description: How many fewer distance lookups vs brute force (brute=1.0). Machine-independent speed proxy.

aknn_real_pois.description: AkNN query correctness. COL-Tree returns exact results using landmark-based LB pruning.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness vs brute force for AkNN queries.

candidates_ratio.description: Fraction of objects examined during AkNN query. Lower = more efficient pruning.

range_real_pois.description: Range query correctness. COL-Tree returns exact results with LB/UB pruning.
